skill.name: icp-builder
skill.description: Turn an interview about your offer, customers, and buyers into Leadsets search filters. Test the company filters on a small sample and save both filter sets for future prospecting.
skill.summary: Build an ideal customer profile from an interview and save reusable Leadsets filters.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The flagged backticks format documentation, and the reconnaissance hits describe API behavior or output validation. The URLs are documentation links or the expected Leadsets endpoint, with no evidence of covert transfer. Saving interview answers to a Google Sheet can expose business information if the sheet is shared.

remediation.issue: A writable Google Sheet can have viewers who should not see interview answers or customer examples.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the exact sheet and its intended audience before writing. Save only the filters by default, and require explicit approval before including source answers or customer domains.

content.value_statement: A broad customer description can produce prospect lists with companies that do not fit. Turn your answers into Leadsets filters, test them on a small company sample, and save them for reuse.
actual_capabilities: Ask up to seven questions about your offer, target companies, buyer roles, and exclusions.
Translate your answers into separate company and people filters and explain the basis for each.
Check Leadsets quotas before testing the company filters with a one-record probe and a small sample.
Show why sample companies match and refine filters based on your feedback.
Save confirmed filters and sample results to a local JSON file or a Google Sheet the agent can edit.
limitations: Live probes require a Leadsets account and a configured MCP connection or REST API access.
The skill tests company filters only. It does not search for people, enrich contacts, or verify email addresses.
Returned company records count against your Leadsets quota. A small sample does not establish how well the filters work across the market.
The skill does not scrape websites, update a CRM or sequencer, or store the profile inside Leadsets.

use_cases.title: Define your first target market
use_cases.description: Use your offer and best customers to define a company segment and the buyer roles to look for later.

use_cases.title: Set targeting criteria for a new client
use_cases.description: Turn client answers into a profile with documented exclusions. Review sample companies with the client before saving the profile.

use_cases.title: Fix filters that return unsuitable accounts
use_cases.description: Review a small sample with match reasons, add exclusions, and save revised filters for future prospecting.

prompt_templates.title: Define your first profile
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with an offer but no formal targeting criteria.
prompt_templates.prompt: We sell forecasting software to sales teams. Interview me to define our ideal customer profile. Ask one question at a time.

prompt_templates.title: Turn a target segment into filters
prompt_templates.scenario: You already know your target market and buyer roles.
prompt_templates.prompt: Target US fintech companies with 50 to 200 employees and revenue operations directors as buyers. Exclude agencies and show which answers produced each filter.

prompt_templates.title: Test filters within a record budget
prompt_templates.scenario: Review sample matches before you reuse the filters.
prompt_templates.prompt: Check our Leadsets quota and spend no more than 12 search records. Show each sample company and why it matched. Ask before relaxing a requirement.

prompt_templates.title: Validate and save a reusable profile
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the company filters against the approved customer domains I provide. Report mismatches and ask me to confirm the sample. Save the confirmed profile locally as icp-fintech-us.json.

output_examples.input: Build and save a profile for US software companies with 50 to 200 employees. Target heads of revenue and exclude agencies.
output: Company criteria: US software companies with 50 to 200 employees. Agencies are excluded.
Buyer criteria for later searches: heads of revenue.
The one-record probe matched. You confirmed all 10 sample companies. The searches used 11 records.
Saved the confirmed filters to icp-software-us.json.

output_examples.input: Test our criteria for Canadian fintech companies with 200 to 500 employees. Tell me if the search returns no matches.
output: The first probe returned no companies and used no search records.
Widening the headcount range to 100 to 500 returned one company. It matched the industry and country criteria.
The broader criteria are not confirmed. No profile was saved.

best_practices: Provide two to five approved customer domains and explain why those companies fit.
Separate strict requirements from preferences and set a search record budget before probing.
Review the sample companies and confirm who can access the save location before including interview answers.
anti_patterns: Using a market label like mid-market without defining a headcount range.
Treating a few company matches as proof that the buyer filters will return relevant contacts.
Saving confidential customer examples to a shared sheet without checking who can view it.

faq.question: Do I need Leadsets to test my filters?
faq.answer: Yes. Live testing requires an account and either a connected Leadsets MCP server or REST API access with a Leadsets key.

faq.question: What should I provide before starting?
faq.answer: Describe what you sell and who buys it. Share target countries, company size, exclusions, and approved customer examples when available.

faq.question: How many records can testing use?
faq.answer: The default probe budget is 25 search records. You can set a lower limit. Leadsets charges for returned records, not empty results.

faq.question: Does the skill find people or verify emails?
faq.answer: No. It prepares buyer filters for later searches and only tests the company filters.

faq.question: Where is the profile saved?
faq.answer: The default is a named JSON file in the working folder. You can also choose a Google Sheet the agent can edit.

faq.question: What happens when the first probe finds no companies?
faq.answer: The skill can relax one filter at a time and report each change. It should flag a zero-result profile before saving.
